messages.text: Need an underwriting exception look on {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0008}}'s auto refi. DTI comes in at 47% against our 45% policy cap. Strong payment history on a_00015 though. Rita, can you eyeball it?
Pulling it up in LoanDesk now. What's driving the DTI, the new revolving balance or the income calc?
Mostly a card balance that jumped about $3,200 on the latest pull. The client says it's a one-time medical-free home repair and is paying it down this month.
Rita, I ran the cash flow on c_0008. Excluding that card paydown, DTI drops to roughly 43.5%. Residual income is solid. Happy to attach my worksheet to the exception request.
Thanks Richard, please do. I'd want a payoff letter or a statement showing the paydown before I sign off. Compensating factors: 6 years of on-time history, LTV at 78%, and stable employment verified.
Heads up, exceptions over 2 points on DTI need my signoff per policy. Martin, document it in the exception log with the compensating factors. I'm fine in principle if the paydown is verified.
Will do, Kara. I'll ask {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0008}} to send the statement through the secure upload, not email. Should have it by tomorrow morning.
Separate question: Kara, is {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0019}} on your list for an exception too? I saw a note on a_00041 about a payment-to-income override.
Different situation, Kathleen. c_0019 is low risk and the loan is already booked, so no new exception. That note was just a documentation update. I'll close it out.
Martin, once the statement is in I'll approve with conditions: paydown verified, card balance under $1,000 at funding, and the 2-point DTI exception logged. Fair?
Fair. I'll relay the conditions to the client today and update the pipeline status to pending conditions.
